lookups.why: Verify that AppAuth::from_env reads TINYSWEEPER_APP_ID and TINYSWEEPER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY verbatim, as the diff comments claim.
Confirm the exact environment variable names the binary reads for App authentication.
Check whether the old names TINYSWEEPER_GITHUB_APP_ID / TINYSWEEPER_GITHUB_PRIVATE_KEY are truly never read by the binary.

value.summary: The change adds missing API-key env vars, fixes the App auth env-var names to match what server::auth::AppAuth::from_env reads (verified), and mounts the config file the server needs. Lookups confirm the renamed vars and the config path; no bugs found in the diff.
